author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-auto-gamma: Label-free γ Selection + Balanced Cosine kNN (k=42)
abstract: Implements a label-free, dataset-agnostic selector for γ in ridge residualization of PCs against batch. We sweep a small γ grid and choose the smallest γ within 1% of min PCR that maximizes a cross-batch mixing proxy on a subsample; then build a batch-balanced cosine kNN graph (k=42, binary). Goal: match/beat γ=0.75 defaults while keeping parsimony and generality.
